pair_design.mutation_description: Return value changed from x*2 to x*3 on non-exception path
Loop body changed from sum accumulation to product accumulation
Function call order changed: validate→process→finalize vs process→validate→finalize
Monolithic function extracted into 4 helper functions
Binary search 'not found' sentinel changed: return -1 → return len(arr)
Unreachable `if False:` block inserted; never executes
RHS of swap changed from lst[j] to lst[i] — identity assignment, no swap occurs
try/except replaced by isinstance guard; identical behavior, zero exceptions raised
Loop bound changed from range(n) to range(n+1) — off-by-one
Internal list replaced with collections.deque; interface and behavior identical

known_results_from_adversarial_review.caveat: These results are from the behavioral output oracle, NOT from the output-free SBG distance predictor. RQ6 status: UNMEASURED for output-free predictor.
